1.w: A Psalm of Asaph. God of gods, YHWH, speaks and calls the earth, from the rising of the sun to the going down.

2.w: From Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines forth.

3.w: Our God comes and will not be silent; before His face a fire devours, and all around Him it will storm exceedingly.

4.w: He calls to the heavens from above, and to the earth, for the judging of His people:

5.w: “Gather to Me My holy ones, those having cut a covenant with Me by sacrifice.”

6.w: And let the heavens declare His righteousness—for God Himself is Judge. Selah

7.w: “Hear, O My people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against you: I [am] God, your God.

8.w: [It is] not over your sacrifices [that] I rebuke you, or your burnt offerings before me continually.

9.w: I will not take a bull from your house [or] male goats from your folds.

10.w: For every living [thing] of the forest [is] unto Me, [and] the cattle on a thousand hills.

11.w: I know every bird of the mountains, and the wild beast of the field [is] unto Me.

12.w: If I were hungry, I would not say [it] to you, for the world and its fullness [is] to Me.

13.w: Do I eat the flesh of bulls, and do I drink the blood of goats?

14.w: Make a sacrifice of thanksgiving to God, and fulfill to the Most High your vows.

15.w: And call on Me in the day of distress, [and] I will rescue you, and you will glorify Me.”

16.w: And to the wicked God says, “What to you [is] to recount My statutes, and to lift up My covenant upon your mouth?

17.w: And you have hated instruction, and cast My words behind you!

18.w: If you see a thief, then you are pleased with him, and your portion [is] with those committing adultery.

19.w: With your mouth you send forth evil, and your tongue weaves deceit.

20.w: You sit against your brother and speak; against the son of your mother you place fault.

21.w: These [things] you have done, and I kept silent; you thought I was just like you. I will rebuke you and set in array before your eyes.

22.w: Understand this, please, [you] forgetting God, lest I tear [you] in pieces, and there is no one to deliver!

23.w: The one making a sacrifice of thanksgiving honors Me, and he [who] sets [his] path, I will make to look on the salvation of God.”
